projects.name: Semantic-Based Medical Image Retrieval
projects.summary: April 2026 – Present. Core Team Member, Qiushi Academic Project, Renmin University of China. Advisor: Assoc. Prof. Wenping Zhang.
highlights: Conducted literature review on semantic medical image retrieval and knowledge-enhanced representation learning; contributed to the research proposal, technical plan, and presentation materials.
Contributed to model design and PyTorch implementation for cardiac image retrieval using real-world clinical data; project recommended for the National College Student Innovation Training Program.

projects.name: Physics-Informed Video Prediction for Ink Diffusion in Water
projects.summary: May 2026 – July 2026. Course Project, Introduction to Deep Learning. Advisor: Prof. Suyun Zhao.
highlights: Co-developed a physics-informed video prediction model in a four-member team; handled data processing and implemented the physics-informed prediction module.
Reduced test MSE by 28.6% over the TAU-only baseline (280 to 200), achieving 0.9420 SSIM and 32.11 dB PSNR through iterative training and controlled ablation studies.

projects.name: Logic Formula Toolkit and Benchmark Suite
projects.summary: March 2026. Course Project, Discrete Mathematics. Primary Developer.
highlights: Served as the primary developer of a Python toolkit for propositional formula parsing, truth-table generation, postfix evaluation, and canonical normal forms.
Implemented and benchmarked multiple C++ evaluation methods, including OpenMP and SIMD-optimized variants; designed the benchmark pipeline and performance experiments.

projects.name: Mirror — 2D Fighting Game
projects.summary: December 2025 – March 2026. Team Project, 9th “Bambu Lab Cup” Tsinghua University Software Design Competition.
highlights: Co-authored the game design document and implemented character-control and combat systems in Unity, delivering a complete, playable competition entry.
